recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中許多紅血球的中央淡染區呈狹長裂縫狀（口形紅血球，stomatocytes），夾雜少數小而深染的球形紅血球，C 圖新亞甲藍染色可見網狀紅血球增加，符合地中海型口形紅血球症/巨大血小板減少症。
features: Numerous stomatocytes with slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor (panels A and B)
Occasional small, dense spherocytes lacking central pallor
Mild anisocytosis with occasional large oval red cells
Platelets scattered, some appearing relatively large compared with normal (macrothrombocytes)
Panel C: supravital new methylene blue stain showing several reticulocytes with blue reticular precipitate (reticulocytosis)
describe_en: Peripheral blood film shows a red cell population with frequent stomatocytes characterized by slit-like central pallor, accompanied by mild anisocytosis, occasional oval macrocytes and a few small dense spherocytes. Scattered platelets are present, some of which appear enlarged, although platelet size is difficult to judge precisely at this magnification. A supravital new methylene blue preparation demonstrates increased reticulocytes, indicating a compensatory marrow response to hemolysis. In the context of macrothrombocytopenia, these findings are suggestive of Mediterranean stomatocytosis/macrothrombocytopenia (sitosterolemia).

ddx.vs: Overhydrated hereditary stomatocytosis shows stomatocytes with macrocytosis and increased MCV but normal platelet size and count, and normal plant sterol levels.
HS shows predominantly spherocytes with raised MCHC and abnormal EMA binding rather than a predominance of slit-like stomatocytes.
Acquired stomatocytosis occurs with a supporting clinical history and lacks inherited macrothrombocytopenia and elevated serum phytosterols.
Artifactual stomatocytes appear only in thick areas of the film, whereas true stomatocytes persist in the optimal monolayer and in wet preparations.
